summary: The user asked again to rebuild agnestoth.com exactly, this time in React. The request was declined for the same reason: an exact clone would reproduce the brand's copyrighted design, photography, and copy. No code was added. Offered again to build an original luxury handbag site in React if they provide a brand name, palette, and sections.
current_status: The handbag-design workspace remains empty of application code. No React app has been created. Waiting on an original design brief.
